name: The Neon Rush
description: A neon arcade game built around story chapters, daily missions, mini-games and a hangar of ships and skins.
problem: A game needs a reason to come back on a normal Tuesday, not just a good first level. The Neon Rush wraps its arcade play in a command center — chapters, objectives, records and unlocks — so a short session always has a next thing to chase.

results.label: Modes
results.note: Three ways into the same game.

solution: Everything hangs off one command center: the story chapter, the daily and weekly missions, the side quests, the arcade cabinet and the hangar of ships and skins. A daily challenge puts every player on the same modifiers and the same leaderboard, so scores are comparable.
